speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your chief complaints in detail, specifically focusing on your growth history, any fractures you may have suffered, and whether you have experienced any unusual physical features.

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency).

I have noted your history of primary amenorrhea, ambiguous genitalia at birth, severe acne, and bone fragility; would you like me to request results for a 17-hydroxyprogesterone blood test and a bone density scan to confirm this?
